@pcbeingused333 is attempting to deploy a commit to the **Vercel Labs** Team on [Vercel](https://vercel.com).

A member of the Team first needs to [authorize it](https://vercel.com/git/authorize?team=Vercel%20Labs&slug=vercel-labs&teamId=team_nO2mCG4W8IxPIeKoSsqwAxxB&type=github&job=%7B%22headInfo%22%3A%7B%22sha%22%3A%22ecef92d2a339862e7eb60e36e65d0a75a89c67f9%22%7D%2C%22id%22%3A%22QmSLPifnrUqWFRhPECeeMaaQvpeiJdY7C2jgrE5dFcLBqh%22%2C%22org%22%3A%22vercel%22%2C%22prId%22%3A1566%2C%22repo%22%3A%22chatbot%22%7D).

I ran my #1565 reproduction against main (a8989b522fa3) and this PR (ecef92d2a339). On main, Stop disappeared after the first chunk in 5/5 runs; with this PR it stayed visible and enabled in 5/5, and clicking it stopped further text from appearing. The PR's regression test also fails on main and passes here. Completion and edit-and-resend still passed 5/5 each. Thanks for picking this up.
